PI1_player_information_state.declared_before: any TRAIN fit of PI1 and any F2026 / LIVE metric of PI1
PI1_player_information_state.observed: results/r2_transfer_diag.json: transfer realized/forecast monotone in dstr (dest - origin prior-season adjusted net) in F2025 / F2026 / LIVE (<=-10: 1.058/1.068/1.146; >=+10: 0.896/0.938/0.929) and in prior mpg / usage; NO_PRIOR_HISTORY over-forecast 0.953/0.955/0.902
PI1_player_information_state.root_cause: (a) transfer prior-season rates ported without competition-level translation and with too little regression for heavy-role transfers; (b) the no-history population prior is too high
PI1_player_information_state.classes: athleteId transition panel (r1): SAME_TEAM_RETURNER / TRANSFER / NO_PRIOR_HISTORY (season-level, known before the season)

fix.TRANSFER: mu_s *= (1 + s_prev * d_s(x)) / (1 + s_prev * DV1_other_s)  [replaces DV1's constant transfer delta]; d_s(x) = a_s + b_s z_d + c_s z_m; z_d = clip(dest_strength_prev - origin_strength_prev, -25, 25) / 10 with strength = INTERNAL game-model season-final off - def (r3_team_finals, production-native); z_m = (clip(pps_min_per_app, 0, 36) - 20) / 8; s_prev = DV1 prior share
fix.stats: all 7 base stats; combos follow from the joint simulator

PI1_player_information_state.fit_TRAIN: F2025 replay p5_F2025_train3 arm PRODX3 (no DV1 / CTX1) only; Poisson-weighted least squares of (y - mean)/mean on s_prev*[1, z_d, z_m] (TRANSFER) and w (NO_PRIOR_HISTORY), weights = mean, ridge N(0, 0.5^2) per coefficient; frozen before evaluation; the same fit is used for F2026 and LIVE
PI1_player_information_state.evaluation: row_mult arm PRODPI1 = PRODALLB multipliers x PI1 multipliers vs PRODALLB, p5_replay common random numbers, SIMS 2000, single run each on F2026 then LIVE (sequential, 1 process, 1 BLAS thread)

gates.G1: stacked 7-stat dLL (PI1 - ALLB) 95% game-cluster ub < 0 on F2026 AND LIVE
gates.G2: TARGET (TRANSFER + NO_PRIOR_HISTORY rows) stacked ub < 0 on F2026 AND LIVE
gates.G3: PROTECTED: SAME_TEAM_RETURNER stacked ub <= +0.0002 on both; no F2026 stat x class cell ub > +0.002; no stat ub > +0.0005 (both)
gates.G4: COMBOS PRA/PR/PA/RA/STOCKS dRPS ub <= +0.0002 on both
gates.G5: MARKET: live graded prop events (p5 paired OVER reconstruction) model LL point <= PRODALLB point + 0.002
gates.rule: PROMOTE iff G1-G5 all pass. No post-result gate change. Root cause proven + candidate fails -> design a better causal fix; hypothesis disproven -> close.

RD1_rotation_redistribution.declared_before: any TRAIN fit of RD1 and any replay metric of RD1
RD1_rotation_redistribution.observed: results/r6_redistribution_truth.json (box scores; descriptive): one regular out -> teammates minutes x1.12, PTS x1.17, AST x1.17, REB x1.14 (2024-25 and 2025-26); 2+ out PTS x1.42; ~74% of lost minutes absorbed
RD1_rotation_redistribution.root_cause: no teammate redistribution of an absent player's minutes / opportunity (prod/inputs.apply_availability removes the player and flags UNSUPPORTED_ROTATION_SHOCK; JM1 has no team-minutes reconciliation); the game model never sees player availability
RD1_rotation_redistribution.fix: for each team-game with absent regular(s) (pregame: trailing-5 minutes >= 24 and played the previous team game; production trigger = RotoWire OUT / LONG_TERM_OUT resolved before the cutoff): every remaining player's stat mean mu_s *= 1 + theta_s[band] * L_s, L_s = lost_s / (team_s - lost_s) (lost trailing stat of the absent regulars over the trailing stat of the remaining players); band = remaining player's trailing minutes {<10, 10-20, 20-28, 28+}; theta = 1 for all bands would be exact pro-rata conservation of the lost opportunity
RD1_rotation_redistribution.fit_TRAIN: 2024-25 box panel only (redistribution_panel season 2025): WLS of (y / trailing - 1) on L_s per (stat, band), weights = trailing stat, ridge N(0,1); frozen
RD1_rotation_redistribution.evaluation: row_mult arm PRODRD1 = PRODALLB x RD1 (oracle absence = best-case pregame information) vs PRODALLB on F2026 and LIVE (absences derived from the season's own played rows), common random numbers

gates.G1: stacked dLL ub < 0 on F2026 AND LIVE
gates.G2: TARGET rows (teammates in team-games with an absent regular) stacked ub < 0 on both
gates.G3: no stat ub > +0.0005 (both); no F2026 stat x band cell ub > +0.002
gates.PROD_COVERAGE: report the share of realized absent regulars with a pregame RotoWire OUT event (information availability; not a gate)
gates.rule: PROMOTE iff G1-G4 pass; no post-result change

TP1_preseason_team_roster_prior.declared_before: any feature build, fit or game-level metric of TP1
TP1_preseason_team_roster_prior.observed: game model 1.1.0 vs market: MARKET BETTER every season; 2027 close margin MSE +28.6; encompassing b_model ~ 0 (docs/audits/2026-11-25-game/results/g2_vs_market_GC3pl.json)
TP1_preseason_team_roster_prior.root_cause_hypothesis: the preseason team prior (GC3: rho x last season's final strength) uses no roster information: returning minutes / value, transfers in / out, recruits (all known before the season from CBBD rosters, portal, recruiting)
TP1_preseason_team_roster_prior.features: per (team, season s), roster(s) = CBBD teams/roster membership (historical core.rosters; 2027 production cache 2026-11-12) joined by athleteId-anchored canonical ids to season s-1 stats: RET = returning minutes share of s-1 team minutes; RV / LV = returning / lost value; TV = transfers-in value; TVd = transfers-in value x clip(dest - origin internal strength, -25, 25)/10; RC = recruit class (year s-1) rating sum; value v = PORPAG x games / 30 (s-1)
TP1_preseason_team_roster_prior.model: strength_s = b0 + b1 x0 + b2 x0 (RET - 0.5) + b3 RV + b4 LV + b5 TV + b6 TVd + b7 RC, x0 = rho_carry x final strength_{s-1} (the GC3 strength prior); ridge (lambda 1 on standardized features), rolling: for target season s fit on seasons 2016 .. s-1 only (final internal strength = target); level and pace keep GC3
TP1_preseason_team_roster_prior.injection: the season-s Ratings prior: strength replaced by the TP1 prediction, level = GC3 level; GR.fit / predict unchanged; 2024, 2025 (historical) and 2027 (live) walk-forward exactly as g1_backtest

gates.T1: margin squared-error diff (TP1 - GC3) game bootstrap ub < 0 on 2024 AND 2025
gates.T3: total MSE diff ub <= +0.5 on 2024 and 2025; 2027 point <= +1.0
gates.T4: moneyline log loss diff ub <= +0.001 on 2024 and 2025
gates.T5: PROTECTED |model margin| >= 12 band margin MSE diff point <= +0.5 each season
gates.T6: TARGET early season (min games played <= 8) margin MSE diff point < 0 on 2024 and 2025
gates.rule: PROMOTE iff T1-T6 pass; no post-result change
